authorization: Author approved the n rule and delegated B/concurrency selection after inspecting the machine

n_rule.selection: largest feasible n using p95 complete main/coarse-K/coarse-dt CPU bundle time plus fixed validations, all with 30% reserve
n_rule.if_n30_exceeds_budget: HOLD or versioned DL increasing B before sampling

budget_scope: complete confirmation including registered validation and bounded escalation; summed CPU time across workers

workers.unit: independent worker processes; one BLAS/OpenMP thread each
workers.selection_after_memory_profile: min(4, floor((min(6 GiB, MemAvailable - 3 GiB) - 0.5 GiB pool overhead)/measured conservative peak worker RSS)); HOLD if less than one
workers.extra_requirement: profile one worker first during preregistered numerics calibration; start two only if the memory formula permits, otherwise one or HOLD; use worst observed peak RSS and current load before increasing parallelism

memory_policy.on_limit: checkpoint/pause without partial scoring; lower concurrency or HOLD; do not drop regimes
memory_policy.enforcement_status: PLANNED_NOT_OS_ENFORCED; audited execution backend still deferred

wall_time.note: CPU-hours divided by workers is only an ideal equivalence, not measured wall-time or a machine-capacity guarantee

change_policy: version + DL before changing B/rule; resource scheduling may adapt to measured RAM/load without changing registered regimes or scoring
